name: @tizonai/hyperui
description: Product copilot for anything with a UI: one entry point (/hyperui) that profiles the user, shows designs before building, plans (spec), builds with language rules and TDD, reviews security and complexity, and guides shipping (domain, hosting, payments by country) and infra — with per-project memory in .hyperui/.

scripts.version-check: node -e "const p=JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('.claude-plugin/plugin.json','utf8')).version,n=require('./package.json').version;if(p!==n){console.error('[hyperui] version mismatch: package.json '+n+' != .claude-plugin/plugin.json '+p);process.exit(1)}console.log('[hyperui] version ok: '+n)"

author: Stevenson Contreras
